title: Some of the expected rewards are not distributed
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `transferPlayerRewards()` function recalculates the rewards to be distributed to the player and their referral.  In the case there is no referral, only 80% are expected to be distributed.  If there exists a referral all the rewards are expected to be distributed, but only 99% are distributed due to how they are calculated.
